title: Years old question answered by mall person
content: In highschool I worked at a Chinese buffet, we used these little sweeper things that were not electric or battery powered. They basically swept the carpet and had a little compartment inside to catch the dirt. We called them ‘hoakies’ .. 🤷🏻‍♀️ For years I’ve been trying to find these things. What they are really called. I mean like off and on for 15 years. Well a mall person was using one last night, I asked what it was called and she told me it was a ‘bissell pick up’ I googled it and that is it. That’s what I’ve been searching for. Thank you whoever told me! My cats will be very happy to not see the vacuum as much!
